data.one_liner: Checks if a pub package is up to date and can trigger updates
data.what_it_does: PubUpdater queries pub.dev for the latest version of a package and compares it to a supplied current version. It can also run the update command to bring a package to its latest release.
use_when: You need a CLI tool to verify package versions during development or CI
You want to prompt users to upgrade dependencies automatically
avoid_when: You need a full dependency management solution beyond simple version checks
You require integration with other package managers
strengths: Handles pre-release and stable releases correctly
weaknesses: Only works with pub.dev or self-hosted pub servers
Limited to Dart packages, not Flutter plugins with platform code
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import 'package:pub_updater/pub_updater.dart'; no special permissions or build steps
